title: PlayMax ⚡ Naya Auto-Play & Anti-Stall Update (v1.5.3)
message: Auto-pause problem 100% solve ho chuki hai! Star Sports aur sabhi channels bina ruke instant auto-play honge. Aage dekhne ke liye app update karein.
releaseNotes: ⚡ Instant Auto-Play: Channel open karte hi turant video chalu
🛡️ Zero Auto-Pause: Network buffer ya stutter aane par video freeze/pause nahi hogi, turant auto-resume hogi
⏩ Controls Auto-Hide: Screen par pause button ka bug fix ho chuka hai
🏏 Star Sports 1 Hindi & all sports ultra-smooth feed
